text.es: Ya no hay vuelta atrás, yo no concibo mi vida sin ti. Contigo siento que puedo enfrentarme al mundo entero. Lo único que podría acabar conmigo es perderte.
text.en: There's no going back now, I can't conceive of my life without you. With you I feel I can face the whole world. The only thing that could destroy me is losing you.
